Utilities/Energy.titulo: NextEra Dominion Deal Reshapes Regulated Utilities And Clean Energy Scale
Utilities/Energy.descripcion: NextEra Energy (NYSE:NEE) announced a proposed all stock acquisition of Dominion Energy valued at US$66.8b. The combined company is expected to become the world's largest regulated electric utility and a global leader in clean energy and battery storage. The transaction, if completed, would mark one of the biggest utility sector deals to date and could reshape the US power sector.
